encoding: ASCII subset of UTF-8, LF, final LF; no blank/trailing unknown records
xref: File format 1; header ends at # SVDB: End of header.; summary pin count 4, rows use 0 namespace indices; no EOF terminator; entire file consumed; optional X preserved and not admitted
net_names: count is third token of 0 0 count timestamp; unique names; END OF RESPONSE to EOF; opener 20000 opaque, not geometry precision
net_index: 1-based ordinal of NET NAMES; query-run scoped opaque; join nXref by lvs_name
response: Device_Info/Net_Shapes 20000, Info:, 0 0 metadata_count timestamp, metadata lines (last first layer); layer, opaque 1 1 0 timestamp, p 1 4, four y x vertices; repeated layers allowed only as listed; END OF RESPONSE
metadata: DEVICE INFO: numeric device-type lexeme plus first-layer tag (both opaque); NET SHAPES: first-layer tag. No pin/property semantics inferred; section tuple opaque due source ambiguity

geometry.rectangle_proof: four distinct corners; two x and y values; alternating orthogonal nonzero edges; implicit closing edge; preserve full vertices
geometry.quality: exact only after rectangle proof + registry, never copied from nonexistent raw quality token

identity: explicit query requests manifest supplies object; no filename-inferred identity; record IDs are authored ordinal labels
unknown_structure: reject; no bbox downgrade or legacy float-rounding fallback
limits: fixed fixture subset only; future product importer separate
